title: A型木脚付きアーチェリー的
description: 練習場の背景や体育施設の用具区画へ置く、自立式の円形アーチェリー的。厚い繊維色の円盤、段差のある独自配色の同心円面、外周押さえ、木製A型脚、下受け、背面の横桟と斜材、開き止め金具を造形。弓・矢・番号・競技用表示は含みません。的と架台は一式1点で、射撃判定・貫通挙動・競技規格・実用品安全性は未検証です。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.196 × 2.028 × 1.169 m、20,512三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A freestanding circular archery target for practice-area backdrops and sports-facility equipment scenes. It has a thick fiber-colored disk, stepped concentric face in an original plain color arrangement, side retainers, wooden A-frame legs, lower ledge, rear bearers/diagonal and metal spreaders. Bows, arrows, numbers and competition markings are absent. Target and stand form one assembly; hit detection, penetration behavior, competitive specifications and real-equipment safety are unvalidated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.196 × 2.028 × 1.169 m; 20,512 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
